1:
AN ORDINANCE TO ESTABLISH RENTAL CHARGES FOR THE GROVER AND LUCILLE HOOD COMMUNITY CENTER; TO ESTABLISH AMOUNT OF DEPOSITS; TO ESTABLISH HOURS OF OPERATION; TO PROVIDE FOR A RENTAL AGREEMENT; TO PROHIBIT ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES, PROFANE LANGUAGE AND HORSEPLAY; AND TO PROVIDE FOR REPEAL OF CONFLICTING ORDINANCES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES.

WHEREAS, BE IT ORDAINED by the Town Council of Clermont, Georgia, and it is resolved and ordained by the authority of same, that the following provisions shall apply to the operation of the Grover and Lucille Hood Community Center:
2: . In order to preserve the order, peace, and dignity of the Grover and Lucille Hood Community Center, the town Council of Clermont has determined that the following regulations shall apply to said property.
3:
Except as provided otherwise in this ordinance, the Community Center shall be rented to any interested party according to the following fee schedule:

- 1. $25.00 Four (4) hour maximum (4 day)

- 2. $50.00 Eight (8) hour maximum (full day)
4:
Except as otherwise provided in this ordinance, each party shall tender a refundable damage deposit in the amount of $25.00 before it is eligible to receive access to the

Community Center. Upon an inspection and finding by either the Town Manager or Town Clerk that the party has caused no damage to the Center, the deposit shall be refunded in full. However, if there is a finding by either of these two town officials that the depositing party has caused physical damage to the property, an amount of the deposit proportionate to the damage will be kept by the Town. The damage deposit shall not represent the Town’s exclusive remedy for any property damage. If the damage exceeds the amount of deposit, the Town may seek redress from the responsible party through all available legal avenues.
5: Each party shall sign a rental agreement before using the Community Center.
6: Unless otherwise provided by the Town Council, the Community Center shall be open from the hours of 8:00 a.m. until 10:00 p.m., Monday through Sunday.
7:
Specifically excluded from Sections 1, 2, and 3 are those groups which legally qualify as non-profit organizations. Said groups shall be excluded from the effects of these Sections on a once a month basis. If a non-profit group uses the Center more than once a month,

Sections 1, 2, and 3 shall apply to each such subsequent use.
8:
All persons are prohibited from possessing alcoholic beverages upon the

Community Center’s premises.
9: All persons are prohibited from using profane and obscene language and participating in horseplay while on the Community Center’s premises.
10: This ordinance is created by the Town Council pursuant to the authority granted under Article I, Section 1-103, of the Town Charter.
11: Should any section or provision of this ordinance be declared by the courts to be unconstitutional or invalid, such decision shall not affect the validity of the ordinance, as a whole or any part thereof, other than the parts so declared to be unconstitutional or invalid.
12: Where there is an apparent conflict in this ordinance between specific and general provisions, it is the intention hereof that the specific provision shall control.
13: All ordinances and parts of ordinances in conflict herewith are hereby repealed.
14:
The effective date of this ordinance shall be upon approval of the Town Council of the

Town of Clermont, Georgia.
